# Builder.io

> > Builder.io is a visual development platform that bridges design and code, offering Headless CMS, Visual Copilot for Figma-to-code conversion, and enterprise tools for composable commerce.

Builder.io enables teams to transform Figma designs into production code with AI, manage content across channels with a headless CMS, and build scalable design systems. The platform integrates with React, Next.js, Angular, Shopify, and other modern frameworks to accelerate frontend development workflows.

## Key Topics

- Visual Copilot
- Figma integration
- Design-to-code automation
- Headless CMS
- Composable commerce
- Visual Editor
- Builder Blueprints
- Design systems

- Fusion
